# `aitbc service harden`

Apply the aitbc-hermes systemd sandbox pattern to AITBC services.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc service harden [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service` | text | — | no | Single systemd service unit to harden. |
| `--all` | flag | `false` | no | Harden all aitbc-*.service units except shell-script helpers. |
| `--read-write-paths` | text | `/var/lib/aitbc /var/log/aitbc /run/aitbc` | no | ReadWritePaths value for units that do not already have one. |
| `--no-restart` | flag | `false` | no | Do not reload systemd or restart affected services. |
| `--dry-run` | flag | `false` | no | Show what would change without writing files. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc service harden
```
